newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market turnover slips, volume rises.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market turnover slips, volume rises.

text.p: Turnover on Romania's over- the-counter (OTC) market this week thinned to 744 million lei from 795 million a week ago, RASDAQ trading system data showed on Friday.
But volumes rose to 1.6 million shares from around 1.0 million, a RASDAQ report said. It showed OTC market listings also on the rise, with 1,340 at the end of the week from 1,026.

The RASDAQ, which opened in October, is expected ultimately to trade shares in some 5,000 companies. This week it said it planned to list 2,000 stocks by the end of 1996 and further increase listings to 3,000 at end-January.
Fifty stocks were traded on each of the five days of trading this week.
The week's most heavily traded stock was Cozia Forest SA, which closed at 330 lei on Friday, up from 280 on Monday.
The highlight of the week was a new addition to OTC listings -- Romcim SA based in Bucharest, the country's main cement producer and its 10th largest company with a share capital of 370 billion lei.

Romcim closed at 14,500 lei on Friday, up from 12,000 on Wednesday, when it joined the market. Romcim's is the highest quote on Romania's OTC market. ($=3,912 lei) -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
